_readme: Sourced cost figures, recorded exactly as the source states them.
Nothing here is interpreted. Interpretation happens when a cost model is built from
these rows, and the model points back at them. Every row carries its source tier
(A1..D) and what kind of monetary figure it is (actual spend, framework ceiling,
annual budget...), because a framework ceiling is not spending.
Rows marked with a 'derivation' were computed from other rows on this page rather
than stated outright. The derivation string is the whole arithmetic, so a reader can

sources.title: Informacia o vyuzivani sluzieb Leteckeho utvaru Ministerstva vnutra Slovenskej republiky
sources.notes: Government material, effective from 1 January 2021. Primary source for every operating-cost figure this project publishes. The exact session date is not recorded on the downloadable file; the material states its own effect from 2021-01-01. Its internal planning table is consistent with the 3 802 EUR/h rate (768 004 / 202 = 3 802.0), which confirms the figures were read correctly.

sources.title: COST_ENGINE_SPEC_SK.md - project specification
sources.notes: The specification's own statement that the unit's costs historically split roughly 30 % direct / 70 % fixed. Recorded as an analytical indication, not as an official figure.

sources.title: Ministerstvo obrany chce zazmluvnit servis pre lietadla Bombardier
sources.notes: Media report of a Ministry of Defence framework tender for Global 5000 maintenance. Reports a framework maximum of EUR 10 million over four years. A media report of a tender, not the tender document; the notice itself would be tier A3.

sources.title: UVO udelil MO dve nepravoplatne pokuty vo vyske 1,7 miliona eur
sources.notes: Media report of two UVO decisions of 2026-04-16 fining the Ministry of Defence 873 795,52 EUR and 857 965,56 EUR for breaching public procurement law when acquiring the two Global 5000. NOT FINAL - the ministry filed an appeal. The decisions themselves would be tier A4; this is reporting of them.

researchItems.description: Priemerna cena priamych prevadzkovych nakladov na hodinu letu na letunoch (priemer F100 a A319), obdobie 2018-2019
Dlhodoba priemerna vyska priamych prevadzkovych nakladov na hodinu letu na letunoch vratane poplatkov, po zapocitani roka 2020
researchItems.notes: This is the rate the unit's own planning table uses for every listed ministry.

researchItems.description: Rozptyl hodinovej ceny priamych prevadzkovych nakladov letunov na najvyuzivanejsich letiskach: 2 359,55 EUR az 5 300,75 EUR
researchItems.notes: Low 2359.55, high 5300.75. The document attributes the spread to destination, weather, fuel price, handling price, passenger count and other services.

researchItems.description: V roku 2019 bolo vykonanych 1400 letovych hodin na letunoch, z toho cca 840 nie pre ustavnych cinitelov alebo MV SR
Minimalny nalet na zachovanie kvality a bezpecnosti prevadzky: 600 letovych hodin na letunoch a 600 na vrtulnikoch
Priemerny dlhodoby rozpocet pri minimalnom nalete 600 h letuny + 600 h vrtulniky, bez mzdovych nakladov
researchItems.notes: Explicitly excludes payroll. Covers both the fixed-wing and the rotary fleet.

researchItems.description: Priame prevadzkove naklady na hodinu letu na vrtulnikoch: 1 012 EUR (2018-2019), 812 EUR dlhodobo vratane 2020
researchItems.notes: Out of scope for the tracked fixed-wing fleet, but needed to split the unit's shared budget between the two fleets.

researchItems.description: Ramcova dohoda na komplexne technicke zabezpecenie udrzby lietadiel Global 5000, maximalna hodnota ramca 10 mil. EUR na 4 roky
researchItems.notes: A CEILING, NOT SPENDING. It must never be divided by four years and charged to flights: a framework may go largely undrawn. Recorded as a lead for obtaining the actual invoices, which would be tier A1. Deliberately not used by any cost model.

researchItems.description: Obstaravacia cena lietadla MSN 9513 od United Wings International, kontrakt zo 16./19. decembra 2024
researchItems.notes: Trade press reports two contracts worth USD 23.15 and 24.6 million; which figure belongs to which airframe is not stated, so the pairing here is provisional. Needed for a capital/depreciation component, which no cost model uses yet.

researchItems.description: Obstaravacia cena lietadla MSN 9633 od United Wings International, kontrakt zo 16./19. decembra 2024
researchItems.notes: See 9513. Combined the two contracts total about USD 47.75 million, roughly EUR 46 million.

researchItems.description: Dve pokuty UVO spolu 1 731 761,08 EUR (873 795,52 + 857 965,56) za porusenie zakona o verejnom obstaravani pri nakupe dvoch Global 5000. Rozhodnutia zo 16. aprila 2026.
researchItems.notes: NOT FINAL AND NOT AN OPERATING COST. The ministry filed an appeal, so no money has necessarily been paid and the decisions may be overturned. Deliberately used by no cost model. Recorded because it is a public-money consequence attached to these airframes, and because the file should show what is known before anyone repeats it as settled. UVO found a procurement-law breach and rejected the ministry's strategic-investment exemption argument; no source characterises this as fraud or as a criminal matter, and this project must not either.

researchItems.description: Variabilne (priame) naklady typu Global 5000 podla nezavislych komercnych kalkulatorov: 7 807-8 368 USD/letova hodina. Pri kurze ECB 1,1701 USD/EUR (priemer 2026) to je 6672-7152 EUR/h.
researchItems.notes: COMMERCIAL BENCHMARK FOR THE TYPE, NOT SLOVAK SPENDING. Used only because no Slovak operating figure for the Global 5000 has been obtained; a state operator flying few hours may differ substantially. The interval is deliberately wider than the source spread for that reason.

researchItems.description: Fixna zlozka na letovu hodinu odvodena z benchmarku: celkove 10 298-12 366 USD/h pri 200-325 hodinach rocne, minus variabilne 7 807-8 368 USD/h, teda 1 930-4 559 USD/h = 1649-3896 EUR/h.
researchItems.notes: Derived by subtraction from the same benchmark, so it inherits every weakness of it and adds one: fixed cost per hour depends entirely on annual utilisation, which for these aircraft is not published.

researchItems.description: Typovy a udrzbovy vycvik styroch pilotov na Global 5000, zadany bez sutaze firme Elite Jet, spolu priblizne 1 200 000 EUR. Jedna z objednavok je 164 800 EUR z 5. novembra 2025.
researchItems.notes: A LEAD, NOT A COST INPUT. Journalism, and the figure is a reported total rather than settled invoices. Deliberately used by no model: training is a one-off fixed cost whose allocation depends on how many years and hours it is spread over, and neither is known. Also a caution about provenance — the order numbers read as Letecky utvar MV SR while the ministry is Defence, and this project separates the two on purpose.

benchmarks.label: Priame prevadzkove naklady letunov LU MV SR, dlhodoby priemer
benchmarks.notes: Mid is the long-term planning rate including 2020; low and high are the observed spread across the most-used airports. The two come from adjacent paragraphs of the same document and are framed slightly differently, so the interval is wider than a single-year spread would be.

benchmarks.label: Priame prevadzkove naklady letunov LU MV SR, 2018-2019
Podiel fixnych nakladov na celkovych nakladoch utvaru
benchmarks.notes: The project specification's historical indication of roughly 30 % direct / 70 % fixed. Our own derivation from the A4 annual budget gives about 72 % fixed excluding payroll, which corroborates it independently. Used only to check that the model is not absurd.

annualUtilisation.notes: The only official annual utilisation figure we have for the fixed-wing fleet.
Minimum required to maintain competency, not an observation. Using it as the denominator more than doubles the fixed cost per hour compared with the 2019 actual.

annualFixedCost.derivation: 9 885 780 EUR long-term annual budget at the minimum nalet, excluding payroll, less the direct operating cost at that nalet: 600 h x 3 802 EUR (fixed-wing) + 600 h x 812 EUR (rotary) = 2 768 400 EUR. 9 885 780 - 2 768 400 = 7 117 380 EUR.
annualFixedCost.notes: Derived, not stated. The budget figure is official; the split between direct and fixed within it is our arithmetic, and it excludes payroll and capital entirely.

annualFixedCost.derivation: 7 117 380 EUR organisation-level fixed cost allocated to the fixed-wing fleet by planned flight hours: 600 / (600 + 600) = 50 %. 7 117 380 x 0.5 = 3 558 690 EUR.
annualFixedCost.notes: A second derivation on top of the first. Allocating a shared budget by planned hours is one defensible choice among several; a different allocation method would move this figure.
